visualCharacteristics.purpose: Two-column layout with rich text beside an embedded video
visualCharacteristics.description: 2x1 layout: left column H2 'Cuidado Porto a qualquer hora' with bulleted list (bold lead-ins); right column embedded YouTube video (9FF4w-Bbc4g).

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells. Cell 1: heading and bulleted list (bold lead-ins). Cell 2: a YouTube, Vimeo or .mp4 link, optionally with a poster image (poster: click to play; no poster: the embed loads when scrolled into view)
contentPattern.blockContent: H2 + 5-item benefit list beside a YouTube video
contentPattern.source: One row, two cells: cell 1 H2 'Cuidado Porto a qualquer hora' + bulleted list with bold lead-ins; cell 2 link https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9FF4w-Bbc4g (poster image i.ytimg.com/vi_webp/9FF4w-Bbc4g/sddefault.webp optional) rendered as an embed.

usage: Text + video feature sections, e.g. "Cuidado Porto a qualquer hora".
reuseGuidance: Reuse whenever a columns row pairs text with a video. Cells without a video link behave like plain columns.
